entities.label: Elevated open upland plain — higher than grove/grassland
entities.looks_like: Raised flat or gently rolling terrain band with open horizon, not dense forest

entities.label: Thin grass or dirt over exposed stone — highland surface recipe
entities.looks_like: Muted grass top with grey rock showing through, not deep jungle dirt or desert sand

entities.label: Exposed grey granite/rock patches on highland surface
entities.looks_like: Grey stone cubes or rocky top-color on highland cells

entities.label: Sparse low scrub/shrub cubes — not a forest
entities.looks_like: Small low green/brown cubes at low spawn rate across open highland

entities.label: Hardy tussock grass tufts on thin soil
entities.looks_like: Short vertical grass-green cubes in clumps, distinct from lush meadow

entities.label: Cool muted highland grass tint — not jungle lime or desert tan
entities.looks_like: Grey-green or olive upland colormap on highland cells

entities.label: Highland mist — large soft particles hanging near ground
entities.looks_like: Large pale semi-transparent particles with minimal vertical motion over highland coords

entities.label: Light drizzle rain over highlands — thin falling drops
entities.looks_like: Thin blue/white particle shafts falling over highland band, lighter than jungle rain

entities.label: Headwater spring/rill flowing from highland
entities.looks_like: Small cyan/blue channel or water voxels originating on highland and descending

entities.label: Sparse highland grazers (sheep/goat/llama/hare) grounded on terrain
entities.looks_like: Quadruped voxels on highland cells with terrain-height grounding or idle wander

must_not_present.label: Dense pine/conifer forest as highland flora
Alpine blizzard wind-sheets as highland weather
